title: test(spec): four ruled-class test files declare their measured CI budget
body:
Part of #23180
Clause-②: no

This PR adds only the budget declarations that ruling record `6181973363` (letter B, item 5) assigns to the spec lane. Each of four test files gets one header line, `// test-budget: SECONDS — CLASS: REASON`. Since PR #23595, `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs --diff` reads that line and lists the file only when a window reading goes above the declared budget. The other rows on #23180 stay listed for later rounds.

Each diff is one inserted line at line 2, right below the copyright line. No other line changes: no timeout, no deletion, no project move.

## The readings

**Source:** the hourly `schedule` runs of `ci.yml`, the same population the refresh lane reads. Only runs that **executed** `@objectstack/spec` count (turbo cache miss). Replayed rows are excluded, as the refresh excludes them.

**Window:** every such run after PR #23535 (the liveness read memo, `51b9990f47`) landed. All three runs contain `51b9990f47`: the compare API answers `ahead` with `behind_by` 0 for each. Each value is the vitest module line for the file, in seconds, from the shard that ran spec (`Test Core (1/6)` in all three runs). Each value also matches the run's merged timing table where that table lists the file.

| run (UTC) | head | `build-schemas-check-mode` (repo) | `check-liveness` (local) | `alias-integrity` (local) | `eager-entry-import` (local) | `compliance-families-retirement` (repo) |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `38636949152` 10-14 21:01 | `5fd2c76d6c` | 592.8 | 269.4 | 34.4 | 15.7 | 5.1 |
| `38651452634` 10-14 23:01 | `8226755ee9` | 744.6 | 316.5 | 34.9 | 19.6 | 6.6 |
| `38657693085` 10-15 00:02 | `b57228913a` | 749.9 | 320.4 | 26.0 | 19.9 | 7.7 |
| slowest x 1.25, rounded up to the next 10 s | | 937.3 → **940** | 400.5 → **410** | 43.6 → **50** | 24.8 → **30** | under 10 s, **not declared** |
| card reading (old window) | | 902.1 | 493.4 | 40.8 | 25.7 | 14.6 |

**Replayed runs, for the record.** The five other `schedule` runs in the same span (22:01, 01:12, 02:01, 03:01, 04:01) replayed `@objectstack/spec` from the cache. The refresh does not count them. Their replayed lines come from whichever run filled the cache, and every one is under the budget declared here:

- `build-schemas-check-mode`: 626.95 to 731.05 s.
- `check-liveness`: 239.63 to 320.70 s.
- `eager-entry-import`: 19.3 s (03:01).
- `compliance-families-retirement`: 3.0 s (03:01) and 6.1 s (04:01).

## The declarations

| file | budget | class |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` | 940 | spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture |
| `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.test.ts` | 410 | spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture |
| `packages/spec/src/shared/alias-integrity.test.ts` | 50 | whole-package import |
| `packages/spec/src/eager-entry-import.test.ts` | 30 | whole-package import |

Each REASON states what the file spawns or imports, and the CI reading and run its number comes from. That gives a later re-measure PR the baseline it has to state (ruling item 2).

**The two candidates this seat was asked to decide:**

- **`eager-entry-import.test.ts`: declared.** Its CI readings are 15.7 to 19.9 s, over the 10 s line. Every published entry of the package (19 module entries) is imported first in its own fresh `tsx` child process, plus two unflagged controls. Its subject is the package's whole entry surface, so it takes the `whole-package import` class. Ruling item 5 names it once measured.
- **`compliance-families-retirement.test.ts`: not declared.** Its CI readings are 5.1 to 7.7 s, all under the 10 s line, so a declaration would lift nothing. The reader refuses a budget of 10 s or less anyway. Its import is the system barrel, one domain rather than the whole package, so it would not be literally `whole-package import` either. The card's 14.6 s came from the old window, and the card's own pin (the next refresh list) decides that row.

## PM mechanism assumptions, measured

1. **The old-window readings cannot be used: holds for `check-liveness`, partly for the others.**
   - `check-liveness`: the memo moved it from 493.4 s to 269 to 320 s in CI.
   - `build-schemas-check-mode`, `alias-integrity`, `eager-entry-import`, `compliance-families`: PRs #23535, #23547 and #23575 touch none of these files. They read lower in the new window anyway: 749.9 against 902.1 s, 34.9 against 40.8 s, 19.9 against 25.7 s, and 7.7 against 14.6 s.
   - Each declared budget still sits above that file's old-window reading (940 over 902.1, 50 over 40.8, 30 over 25.7). The exception is `check-liveness`, by design.
   - **No `schedule` run has executed spec since PR #23575 landed:** the 03:01 and 04:01 runs replayed it. Of the three readings, only the 00:02 run includes PR #23547.
2. **"Can the script read Actions logs here": false in this container.**
   - Every artifact download redirects to `productionresultssa*.blob.core.windows.net`, and so does the REST job-log endpoint. The egress proxy refuses that host (CONNECT 403). The artifacts are `test-core-timings-N-of-6` and the 14-day `test-core-timing-table`.
   - So `measure-test-shard-timings.mjs --diff --captures` cannot be fed from here.
   - The readings above were taken through the MCP job-log read, which returns at most the last 5,000 lines of a job:
     - the `Test Core` aggregator job echoes the merged top-20 table, and says whether spec was measured or replayed;
     - the spec shard's tail carries every spec file line.
3. **`readTestBudget(text, label)` is exported at `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs:1264`: holds** (at `8d05456cb`).

## Tests

All local results are at `ccb64dc967`, the PR head.

- **The reader on every changed file.** I ran PR #23595's one-liner on each file; each exited 0 and printed 940, 410, 50 and 30. I then ran the refresh's own tree resolution, `declaredBudgetInTree('@objectstack/spec', FILE)` with the vitest-printed paths. It gave 940, 410, 50 and 30, and `null` for `compliance-families-retirement.test.ts`.
- **Negative control:** a copy of the alias-integrity text with the class misspelled `whole-packge import` is refused at `alias-typo:2`, not skipped.
- **Single-file runs** (under `os-verify-lock.sh`, `--project local --maxWorkers=2`, default reporter), all VERDICT command-exit 0:
  - `alias-integrity.test.ts` 20/20 (18.1 s);
  - `eager-entry-import.test.ts` 22/22 (15.3 s);
  - `check-liveness.test.ts` 71/71 (82.4 s).
- **`build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` was not run locally:** about 900 s on this box, for a comment-only change. CI runs it in the `repo` project.
- **No ablation:** the diff changes no tested behaviour. It is header comments only.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived **77** commands at `ccb64dc967`: 4 paths, +4 / -0. All 77 ran in sequence, and each exit was recorded before any pipe.
- 74 exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, formula and lint not built). After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` it re-ran and exited 0.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure` both exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET). They load other packages' built `dist/` (hono, account, objectql) and cannot read a test-file comment. CI runs both.
- `--ran`: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 77 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 75 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).`
- Also run, both exit 0: `pnpm check:dev-prereqs`, and `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 4 files.
- Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs.

## Publish

Nothing publishes. A packed `@objectstack/spec` (18.0.0-next.1, `npm pack --dry-run`) lists 2,092 files: 0 `*.test.ts`, 0 under `scripts/`, and none of the four files. The positive control, `src/data/field.zod.ts`, is present. The PR therefore carries `skip-changeset`, not a changeset.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- **`compliance-families-retirement.test.ts` read 5.1 to 7.7 s in the three executed runs**, against the card's 14.6 s. It is not declared, and it stays on #23180's list until the next refresh list decides it. Carrier: #23180.
- **An agent container cannot read the per-file captures the refresh reads**, because the blob host is refused. The MCP job-log tail is the only route, and it is capped at 5,000 lines per job. In the three executed runs the spec shard's tail held every spec file line. In the two replayed runs read, it held only part of the replay. Not a defect. Carrier: none.
